content: PWA in Next.js 15 App Router: Use @serwist/next (not old shadowwalker/next-pwa which is unmaintained). @serwist/next is the actively maintained successor, endorsed by the @ducanh2912/next-pwa author. Setup: wrap next.config.js with withSerwist, add service worker file at app/sw.ts. Requires webpack as dev dep. Provides precache manifest, offline fallback, service worker registration. For web manifest: use route.ts in app/manifest.ts (Next.js built-in manifest support) — no separate JSON file needed.
